blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Grounded reasoning, where a model outputs text coordinates of relevant locations in chain-of-thought reasoning, is a common strategy for solving complex visual reasoning problems. However, the benefits and limitations of grounded reasoning are understudied. We study where and why grounded reasoning is most useful. To do so, we introduce a chain-of-thought analysis method to measure how much a model uses its outputted grounding in its thinking trace and perform a detailed ablation study of a grounded reasoning training recipe. We find that grounded reasoning improves counting but shows no significant gain over baselines without coordinate grounding across a wide range of spatial reasoning and perception benchmarks. Using several synthetic tasks, we show that grounded reasoning is most useful when a task requires undescribable references, which are visual concepts that are difficult to describe in language. However, we observe that many existing visual reasoning benchmarks are solvable with only describable text references. To close this gap, we introduce BrickVision, a new benchmark that requires undescribable visual references to solve.
blocks.zh: 基础推理,即一个模型输出文本在思维链推理中相关地点的坐标,是解决复杂的视觉推理问题的共同策略. 然而,对有根据的推理的利弊和局限性的研究不足。 我们研究何地和为什么有根据的推理最有用。 为此,我们采用了一种思维链式分析方法,以衡量一个模型在思维跟踪中在多大程度上使用了其输出的地面,并对一个基于推理的训练方法进行详细研究。 我们认为,有根据的推理改进了计数工作,但如果不在广泛的空间推理和感知基准方面进行协调,则在基线方面没有重大收益。 我们用几个合成任务来显示,当一项任务需要无法描述的引用时,基于推理最有用,这些是视觉概念,在语言中难以描述. 然而,我们发现,许多现有的视觉推理基准只能以可贬低的文字参考来解释。 为了缩小这一差距,我们引入了Brick Vision,这个新的基准需要无法描述的视觉参考来解决.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Visual grounding is useful as an undescribable reference . When objects in a task are uniquely identifiable in text (e.g. through a label, descriptor, or position), we say that a textual reference is available. When textual references are available, grounded reasoning performs no better than text reasoning. When no unique text description is available (e.g. in dense counting or tracing tasks), we say the task requires maintaining undescribable references . Grounded reasoning significantly outperforms text reasoning when the task requires undescribable references.
blocks.zh: 图 1:视觉地基定位作为一种无法描述的参考是有用的。 当任务中的对象在文本中具有独特的可识别性(例如通过标签,描述符,或位置)时,我们说有文本参考. 当有文字参考文献时,有根据的推理表现并不比文字推理更好. 当没有独特的文字描述(例如密集计数或追踪任务)时,我们说任务需要保持无法描述的引用. 在任务需要无法描述的引用时,基于推理大大超过了文本推理.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: While solving visual tasks, humans shift their gaze between objects pertaining to the problem. Grounded reasoning models mimic this behavior by enabling a vision language model (VLM) to output text coordinates while reasoning. Grounded reasoning has a number of appealing properties. It can reduce hallucinations by anchoring the VLM to certain regions of the image and serves as an interpretable way of diagnosing model failures. Moreover, recent text-coordinate-based grounded reasoning methods do not require reprocessing of cropped images or replaying of visual features 1 1 1 Throughout this paper, we use “grounded reasoning” to refer to models and techniques that only output text coordinates during reasoning, as opposed to adding cropped images or features into context. . For these reasons, training recipes for grounded reasoning have received broad interest ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Sarch et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 在解决视觉任务的同时,人类在与问题相关的物体之间转移视线. 基础推理模型通过使视觉语言模型(VLM)在推理的同时输出文本坐标来模仿这种行为. 基于理由的推理有若干具有吸引力的财产。 它能通过将VLM锚定在图像的某些区域来减少幻觉并成为诊断模型故障的一种可解释的方法. 此外,最近基于文本坐标的基于推理方法并不要求重新处理所收缩的图像或重放视觉特征1,1 在整个本文中,我们使用“有根据的推理”来指代在推理时只输出文本坐标的模型和技术,而不是在上下文中添加所收缩的图像或特征。 由于这些原因,对有根据的推理的培训方法引起了广泛的兴趣(Lu等,2026;Wang等,2026a; 张等,2026b; Sarch等,2026.).

blocks.en: However, it remains unclear where and why grounded reasoning is most useful. For instance, recent results from iVGR ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) suggest that, on certain tasks, text-only reasoning modes can outperform grounded reasoning. On the other hand, works such as Thinking with Visual Primitives ( Lu et al., 2026 ) find improvements across a range of general VQA tasks. As such, an important goal is to understand which tasks necessitate the additional complexity of grounded reasoning and which domains can be solved with natural language reasoning. In this work, we investigate the following question: where and why is grounded reasoning actually necessary to solve a task ?
blocks.zh: 然而,仍然不清楚何地和为何理由最有用。 例如,iVGR(Zhang等人,2026年a)的最近结果表明,在某些任务上,仅文本推理模式可以超过基于理由的推理。 另一方面,与Visual Primitives(Lu等,2026年)等作品在一系列一般的VQA任务中发现了改进. 因此,一个重要的目标是了解哪些任务需要更多复杂的有根据推理,哪些领域可以通过自然语言推理来解决。 在这项工作中,我们调查了以下问题:在什么地方和为什么为了解决一项任务而实际需要有根据的推理?

blocks.en: We first perform a training-free study of whether existing models actually rely on their intermediate grounding outputs to solve tasks. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) interpretability techniques edit or insert mistakes into the chain-of-thought and examine if the model answer changes ( Lanham et al., 2023 ) . We adapt this approach to measure grounding reliance, as opposed to general CoT faithfulness. Simply removing or randomizing points after the CoT is generated is an insufficient test, because the model might have derived information from the coordinates in subsequent text reasoning. We therefore propose a test for measuring grounding usage that repeatedly randomizes the CoT’s emitted points during inference (Figure 2 ). Our method shows that many existing open-source grounded reasoning models do not rely on grounding for perception and spatial reasoning tasks, with performance remaining generally unchanged after coordinate randomization (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先进行一项免费培训研究,研究现有模型是否真正依赖其中间地基产出来完成任务。 现有的思维链(COT)可解释性技术编辑或将错误插入思维链,并检查模型答案是否改变(Lanham等,2023.). 我们调整了这一方法,以衡量依赖的基础,而不是一般的《公约》忠诚。 在生成 CoT 后简单地去除或随机分出点是一个不足的测试,因为模型可能在随后的文本推理中从坐标中得出了信息. 因此,我们提议进行一项测试,以衡量在推论中一再随机抽取二氧化碳排放点的地基用法(图2)。 我们的方法表明,许多现有的开源基于推理模型并不依赖于感知和空间推理任务的地基,在坐标随机化后性能一般保持不变(表1.

blocks.en: In order to understand this phenomenon, we train our own grounded reasoning models and carefully study the effect of different training recipes on downstream performance. We find that the usage of model grounding is sensitive to the accuracy of the grounding coordinates during SFT, but is also generally uncorrelated with spatial reasoning performance. Moreover, even with high-quality reasoning traces and grounding annotations, we find that grounded reasoning is not helpful when compared to a strong text-only reasoning baseline on perception and reasoning benchmarks (Table 3 ). In contrast, we find that grounded reasoning is helpful for counting benchmarks. How can we explain why grounding is helpful for counting tasks but not for spatial reasoning or perception?
blocks.zh: 为了了解这一现象,我们培养了我们自己的立足的推理模型,并仔细研究了不同的训练配方对下游性能的影响. 我们发现模型地平面的使用对SFT期间地平面坐标的准确性很敏感,但也一般与空间推理性能无关. 此外,即使有高质量的推理痕迹和基础说明,我们仍认为,与关于感想和推理基准的强有力的仅以文字为依据的推理基线(表3)相比,有根据的推理没有帮助。 相反,我们认为,有根据的推理有助于计算基准。 我们如何解释为什么地面对计算任务而不是空间推理或感知有帮助?

blocks.en: We hypothesize that the major value of grounded reasoning is when a task requires maintaining undescribable references , which are visual concepts that are difficult to describe in language (Figure 1 ). To demonstrate this, we develop a suite of evaluations across tracing, counting, and tracking tasks. For each benchmark, we train a model on high-quality, in-domain chain of thought traces for both text-only and grounded reasoning. When visual concepts are hard to describe with text, the benefit of grounding is large. Conversely, when labels are added to the task, the marginal value of grounding over pure-text reasoning drops significantly (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们假设,基于推理的主要价值是当一项任务需要维持无法描述的引用时,这是难以用语言描述的视觉概念(图1)。 为了证明这一点,我们制定了一套涵盖追踪、计数和跟踪任务的评价。 就每个基准而言,我们对高质量、内在的思维跟踪链进行模式培训,既包括文本,也包括有根据的推理。 当视觉概念难以用文字描述时,地基化的好处是巨大的. 反之,当在任务中添加标签时,对纯文本推理进行定位的边际值会大幅下降(图4 .

blocks.en: We observe that most existing visual reasoning benchmarks struggle to demonstrate the benefit of grounded reasoning because they are mostly solvable with describable references. To close this gap, we use insights from our study to design BrickVision, a challenging new visual reasoning benchmark that requires maintaining undescribable references. On BrickVision, models such as GPT-5.6 Sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash score just 18.9% and 15.5%, respectively (Table 4 ). GPT-6 Astra is significantly stronger than all other existing models, with a score of 68.7%. Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,大多数现有的视觉推理基准都难以证明有根据推理的好处,因为这些基准大多与可贬低的参考文献相冲突。 为了缩小这一差距,我们利用我们研究的洞察力来设计Brick Vision,这是一个具有挑战性的新的视觉推理基准,需要保持无法描述的参考. 在"BrickVision"上,GPT-5.6 Sol和双子座3.8 Flash等型号分别只得分18.9%和15.5%(表4. GPT-6 Astra比其他所有已存在的型号都强得多,得分为68.7%. 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. We introduce a technique to measure grounding usage in existing reasoning models and find that many open models do not use their generated coordinates when reasoning. 2. We perform a detailed ablation study of the grounding training recipe across spatial reasoning, fine-grained perception, and counting tasks. We find that grounded reasoning outperforms natural language reasoning on tasks that require visual references difficult to describe in language, such as counting and tracking. 3. We introduce BrickVision, a challenging benchmark designed to measure a model’s capability to reason with undescribable visual references. Many frontier models perform poorly on BrickVision, scoring under 30%.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Grounded reasoning models. A longstanding issue for VLMs has been over-reliance on textual priors ( Asadi et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Vo et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025b ; Kancheti et al., 2026 ) , which weakens perception and visual reasoning performance. As such, a large variety of techniques exist to enable models to reground to an image during reasoning. One common approach is to format the re-grounding operation as a tool call, which then runs a crop or zoom operation ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . However, repeatedly processing images through tool calls adds significant overhead. An alternative approach is to replay a subset of the original image’s features into the context ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . This method requires specialized training and modules to process image tokens, adding significant complexity to model design. Coordinate-only grounding approaches, where a model simply interleaves text coordinates during reasoning, enable a model to reason over grounding without accumulating image tokens or requiring any bespoke architectural changes. These properties are highly appealing, and as such, a number of recent works have focused on developing training recipes for grounded reasoning ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Dohmann & PerceptronAI, 2026 ; Sarch et al., 2026 ) . For these reasons, we opt to primarily study coordinate-only grounding over other grounded reasoning variants.
blocks.zh: 基础推理模型. 对于VLMs来说,一个长期的问题就是过度依赖文字前传(Asadi等,2026;Chen等,2024;Vo等,2026;Bai等,2025b;Kancheti等,2026),这削弱了感知和视觉推理表现. 因此,存在着多种技术,使模型能够在推理过程中重新定位到图像. 一种常见的方法是将再定位操作格式化为工具调用,然后进行收割或缩放操作(郑等,2026. 然而,通过工具调用反复处理图像增加了可观的间接费用。 另一种方法是将原始图像的一个子集重新放在上下文中(Wang等人,2026b.). 这种方法需要专门的培训和模块来处理图像符号,为模型设计增加了显著的复杂性. 仅以坐标定位的方法,即一个模型在推理时简单地将文本坐标互放,使一个模型能够在不积累图像符号或要求任何定点建筑改变的情况下在地面上进行推理。 这些属性具有很高的吸引力,因此,最近的一些作品侧重于制定基于理由的推理培训方法(Lu等,2026;Wang等,2026a; 张等,2026a;张等,2026b;多克曼等,2026;萨克等,2026. 出于这些原因,我们选择主要研究仅以协调为基础而不是其他基于推理的变体。

blocks.en: Analysis of grounded reasoning . Recent works have provided some insight into the strengths and weaknesses of grounding. iVGR ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) finds that when grounded reasoning models are prompted not to output coordinates, their performance generally increases across a large range of benchmarks. They attribute this phenomenon to the model making errors in grounding. We find contradictory results: model performance generally remains stable even when all grounding coordinates are forced to be incorrect by our decode randomization. Dohmann & PerceptronAI (2026) performs a similar analysis of the grounded reasoning recipe but only considers the single synthetic task of Set. We benchmark grounding across a variety of real-world evaluation benchmarks and develop several synthetic tasks to illustrate the strength of grounding. Lu et al. (2026) claims that grounded reasoning is helpful for topological reasoning tasks like wire-tracing but does not compare against a matched text reasoning baselines. We provide controlled experiments against text reasoning and propose a more general explanation for where grounded reasoning is most useful.
blocks.zh: 分析有根据的推理 近期的作品对地基的优缺点提供了一些见解. iVGR (Zhang等, 2026a.)发现,当被基于推理模型被促使不输出坐标时,其性能一般会跨越一大批基准而提高. 他们将此现象归因于模型在地平架上制造出错误. 我们发现相互矛盾的结果:模型性能一般保持稳定,即使所有的地基坐标由于我们的解码随机化而被迫不正确. Dohmann & PerceptronAI (2026年)对基于推理的配方进行了相类似的分析,但只考虑Set的单一合成任务. 我们以各种现实世界评价基准作为基准,并制订若干综合任务,以说明基础力量。 Lu等人(2026年)声称,有根据的推理有助于铁丝网等地形推理任务,但没有与匹配的文字推理基线进行比较. 我们提供对照文字推理的有控制的实验,并提出更笼统的解释,说明何为理由推理最有用。

blocks.en: Visual reasoning benchmarks. Precise perception and spatial understanding are widely observed weaknesses of VLMs. As such, a wide range of reasoning benchmarks seek to evaluate VLMs on such capabilities ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) . Lu et al. (2026) , Chen et al. (2026) , and Berman & Deng (2025) also consider the tracing task. However, we use it as a controlled training environment to demonstrate the effectiveness of grounded reasoning over text reasoning and direct fine-tuning, as opposed to an evaluation of the zero-shot capabilities of VLMs.
blocks.zh: 视觉推理基准. 精确感知和空间理解被广泛观察到VLM的弱点. 因此,一系列广泛的推理基准力求评估这种能力的自愿计量标准(刘等,2025;李等,2026;张等,2025;杜等,2024;贾等,2026)。 吕等 (2026年),陈等 (2026年),伯曼等 (2025年)也考虑过追查任务. 然而,我们把它作为一个可控的训练环境,来证明基于逻辑的推理相对于文本推理和直接微调的有效性,而不是对VLMs零射入能力的评价.

blocks.en: Most similar to our work is BabyVision ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , which also considers visual tasks that are difficult to describe in language. However, many BabyVision tasks accept text answer formats and therefore contain textualizable references for objects (e.g., which puzzle piece in the image, labeled A, B, C, D, would fit into the gap). In contrast, objects in BrickVision are unlabeled and placed in irregular locations; as such, undescribable references are necessitated. Moreover, BrickVision uses points as the answer format, which requires greater precision compared to a multiple-choice question and yields a more interpretable analysis of failure modes.
blocks.zh: 与我们的工作最相近的是"宝贝视觉"(Baby Vision (Chen等, 2026)),它也考虑了语言上难以描述的视觉任务. 然而,许多 BabyVision 任务接受文本解答格式,因此包含对象的可文本化的引用(例如,图像中的拼图片,被标记为 A, B, C, D, 将适合入空格). 相形之下,BrickVision中的对象没有被贴上标签并被放入不规则的位置;因此,需要使用无法描述的引用. 此外,"BrickVision"使用点来作为解答格式,与多选题相比,需要更高的精度并产生更能解释的故障模式分析.

blocks.en: 3 Where Is Grounding Useful?
blocks.zh: 3 地面定位有用吗?

blocks.en: Figure 2: Decode Grounding Corruption . We introduce a CoT analysis technique to analyze whether a model uses its grounding. Instead of editing CoT after generation, we randomize the model’s outputted points during decoding and reset the KV-cache.
blocks.zh: 图2:破解腐败的基础 我们采用了CoT分析技术来分析一个模型是否使用了它的地基. 我们不是在生成后编辑 CoT, 而是在解码和重置 KV- cache 时随机化模型的输出点 。

blocks.en: 3.1 Do Models Use Their Grounding?
blocks.zh: 3.1 模型是否使用其地基?

blocks.en: Decode-time Grounding Randomization . We first aim to determine whether existing grounded reasoning models rely on their grounding during reasoning. One approach would be to have the model emit its full reasoning trace and answer, and then measure if the model changes its answer if the coordinates are randomized. However, this approach doesn’t account for information that the model may have already derived from the grounding during further text reasoning. For example, a model that emits the coordinate of two objects may use those coordinates to reason “object A is at [x1,y1] and object B is at [x2, y2], therefore A is to the left of B.” Randomizing just the coordinates after the full reasoning trace is generated would still preserve “therefore A is to the left of B,” which the model could still use to solve the problem.
blocks.zh: 解码时间 地面随机化 。 我们首先要确定现有有根据的推理模型在推理时是否依赖其依据。 一种方法是让模型释放出其充分推理的踪迹和答案,然后测量模型如果改变其答案,如果坐标是随机的. 然而,这种办法并未考虑到模型可能已经产生于进一步文本推理中的基础的信息。 例如,一个发出两个物体坐标的模型可能利用这些坐标来说明理由“物体A位于[x1,y1],物体B位于[x2,y2],因此A位于B左边。” 在产生充分推理跟踪后随机化坐标仍能保留“因此A是B的左边”,该模型仍可用来解决问题。

blocks.en: Therefore, to measure whether existing model checkpoints actually use their grounding coordinates, we introduce a test that corrupts coordinates during decoding . Whenever a model generates a coordinate, we randomize the coordinate and reset the KV-cache using the edited prefix. As such, all future generation is conditioned on a randomized coordinate, which gives a more accurate signal on the effect of the coordinates during reasoning. This method is similar to the “Adding Mistakes” intervention in Lanham et al. (2023) , but is executed programmatically rather than by an LLM inserting a mistake. Moreover, we perform this intervention multiple times per completion, as opposed to doing a single intermediate mistake insertion. For each question, we sample 20 completions at temperature 1.0, and report the change in mean performance (% acc) after randomization.
blocks.zh: 因此,为了衡量现有的示范检查站是否实际使用其地上坐标,我们引入了一个在解码过程中腐蚀坐标的测试。 当一个模型生成一个坐标时,我们随机化坐标,并使用被编辑的前缀来重置KV-cache. 因此,所有后世都以随机坐标为条件,这在推理时对坐标的效果给出了更准确的信号. 这种方法与Lanham等人(2023年)的“增加错误”干预类似,但是由一个LLM插入错误而执行的。 此外,我们每次完成一次多次进行这种干预,而不是进行一次中间错误插入。 对于每个问题,我们在1.0温度下抽取了20个完成,并在随机化后报告平均性能的变化(% acc).

blocks.en: Table 1: Grounding usage experiments. We report change in mean performance (% acc) for our coordinate corruption experiments. Many open models don’t rely on their grounding for spatial reasoning and perception. Our retrained models (below) are more reliant on their grounding outputs.
blocks.zh: 表1:地面使用试验。 我们报告我们协调腐败实验的平均表现的变化(百分比cc)。 许多开放的模型并不依赖它们的地基来进行空间推理和感知. 我们的再训练模型(以下)更依赖于其实地产出。

blocks.en: Existing recipes don’t necessarily lead to grounding usage. We use our grounding randomization technique to analyze grounded reasoning models, such as TreeVGR, iVGR, and DeepEyes, across several benchmarks. We observe that, in general, open models do not significantly use their grounding (Table 1 ), except on counting tasks. This finding re-contextualizes results from iVGR, which finds that models prompted not to use grounding see performance increases. Zhang et al. (2026a) posits that this difference can be attributed to models making grounding errors during reasoning, which the models then incorrectly reason over. However, our results demonstrate that models don’t experience significant performance degradation even when all grounding is forced to be incorrect in our corruption experiments, suggesting that this explanation is incomplete.
blocks.zh: 现有食谱并不一定会导致使用率下降。 我们使用我们的地基随机化技术来分析被基于的推理模型,例如TreeVGR,iVGR,和DeepEyes,跨越了几个基准. 我们注意到,一般而言,开放型号除了计算任务外,没有显著使用其地基(表1)。 这一发现的再编译源于iVGR,它发现模型促使不使用地基,可见性能的提高. Zhang等人(2026a)认为,这种差异可以归因于模型在推理过程中制造地基错误,然后模型错误地解释了原因。 然而,我们的结果表明,即使所有基础都被迫在腐败实验中不正确,模型也不会出现明显的性能退化,这表明这一解释是不完整的。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Training Coordinate Randomization . We randomize varying percentages of coordinates in the SFT set and report task performance and grounding usage. While grounding usage decreases with more randomization, task performance remains relatively flat, except on counting.
blocks.zh: 图3:培训坐标随机化 我们在SFT集中随机列出不同比例的坐标,并报告任务执行情况和地基使用情况。 虽然随着随机化程度的提高而降低基数使用率,但除计数外,任务绩效仍然相对平坦.

blocks.en: 3.2 Studying the Grounded Reasoning Recipe
blocks.zh: 3.2 研究基于理由的食谱

blocks.en: Problem setting and evaluation . Our goal is to study various aspects of the training recipe for grounded reasoning. We train models across many variations of a training recipe and evaluate them over a wide range of public benchmarks where we expect grounding might help. We categorize each benchmark into one of the following broad task types: spatial reasoning, perception, and counting. For spatial reasoning, we evaluate on SpatialMQA (SMQA) ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , MultihopSpatial (MHS) ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , EmbSpatial ( Du et al., 2024 ) , VSR ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , OmniSpatial ( Jia et al., 2026 ) , and ERQA ( Team et al., 2025 ) . For perception, we evaluate on V* ( Wu & Xie, 2023 ) , MME-RealWorld-Lite ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and TreeBench ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . For counting, we evaluate on CountQA ( Tamarapalli et al., 2025 ) and FSC-147 ( Ranjan et al., 2021 ) . We use a randomly selected subset of MultihopSpatial (1500 / 4500) for faster experiment iteration. We find that this sample size is sufficiently large to get reliable, comparative evaluations of models.
blocks.zh: 问题的设置和评价 我们的目标是研究有根据的推理培训方法的各个方面。 我们从多种不同的培训方法中培训模型,并根据各种公共基准对其进行评估,我们期望这些基准的立足点可能有所帮助。 我们把每个基准分为以下广泛任务类型:空间推理、感知和计数。 关于空间推理,我们评价SpaceMQA(SMQA)(Liu等,2025年),MultihopSpatial(MHS)(Lee等,2026年),EmbSpatial (Du等,2024).,VSR (Liu等,2023). OmniSpatial. (Jia等,2026年),和ERQA(Team等,2025年). 为了感知,我们评价V*(Wu & Xie,2023),MME-RealWorld-Lite(张等,2025),和树本奇(Wang等,2026a). 就计算而言,我们对QA伯爵(Tamarapalli等,2025年)和FSC-147(Ranjan等,2021年)进行评估。 我们使用一个随机选择的MultihopSpatial(1500/4500)子集来进行更快速的实验迭代. 我们发现,这种样本规模足够大,可以对模型进行可靠的比较评价。

blocks.en: Unless otherwise specified, we train 3 checkpoints with random seeds. For each trained checkpoint, we evaluate 3 times with separate random seeds at a temperature of 1.0 and report the mean result for each benchmark. On the counting benchmarks (CountQA and FSC-147), we instead decode each checkpoint greedily, as we find that this improves performance significantly. To evaluate the differences between grounded and ungrounded checkpoints, we report the mean performance delta of the grounded performance minus the ungrounded performance (denoted Δ ¯ \bar{\Delta} ). We then compute a 95% confidence interval for the delta (see Appendix A for more detail). We consider a delta significant if the confidence interval does not include zero.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,否则我们用随机种子训练了3个检查站。 对于每个训练有素的检查站,我们用温度为1.0的分出随机种子来评估3次,并报告每个基准的平均结果。 根据计票基准(CountQA和FSC-147),我们却贪婪地解码每个检查站,因为我们发现这大大改善了业绩。 为了评估被禁闭检查站和无禁闭检查站之间的差异,我们报告被禁闭检查站的平均业绩三角洲减去无禁闭检查站。 然后我们计算三角洲95%的置信间隔(详见附录A). 我们认为,如果信任间隔不包括零,三角洲就很重要。

blocks.en: Dataset construction . We observe that existing open datasets have incorrect or low-quality grounding and/or reasoning traces. For instance, the TreeVGR SFT dataset has bounding boxes that are extremely large and generally inaccurate (Appendix 7 ). On the other hand, datasets from Thinking with Visual Grounding ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) have accurate grounding but excessively long thinking traces. As such, we construct our own high-quality SFT datasets based on Zhang et al. (2026b) ’s annotated SpatialMQA and MultihopSpatial sets. We first generate ungrounded thinking traces by prompting Gemini 3.5 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026a ) to produce a rationale for the solution without grounding. We then provide the QA, trace, and ground truth grounding annotations to Gemini 3.5 Flash and prompt the model to edit the trace to incorporate the grounding annotations. We choose to use point annotations over boxes in our grounded reasoning data, as we find points generally perform better than boxes across most benchmarks (Appendix 6 ). Additionally, we filter out samples that contain incorrect coordinates or large quantities of irrelevant grounding coordinates. This yields a high-quality grounded SFT dataset of 6,368 samples. For RL, we use the TreeVGR RL dataset, which is composed of questions from the V ∗ V^{*} train set ( Wu & Xie, 2023 ) and VisDrone ( Zhu et al., 2021 ) . We additionally supplement the RL training set by rolling out both a text and a grounded reasoning SFT checkpoint on the SFT QA set and adding any question with pass@8 ∈ [ 0.2 , 0.8 ] \text{pass@8}\in[0.2,0.8] under both checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 数据集构建. 我们注意到,现有的开放数据集有不正确或质量低的地基和/或推理痕迹。 例如,TreadyVGR SFT数据集的边框非常大,一般不准确(附录7)。 另一方面,用视觉地平面来思考(Zhang等,2026b)的数据集有准确地平面,但思维痕迹过长. 因此,我们根据张等(2026b)附加说明的SpaceMQA和MultihopSpatial数据集构建了我们自己的高质量SFT数据集。 我们首先通过促使双子座3.5 Flash(Google DeepMind, 2026a) 产生无根据思维痕迹, 然后我们向双子座3.5 Flash提供QA,追踪和地面真相定位说明,并促使模型编辑追踪内容,以纳入定位说明. 我们选择用点标注在我们的基于推理数据的框上,因为我们发现点一般表现优于大多数基准的框(附录6). 此外,我们过滤出含有错误坐标或大量不相干地标的样本。 这产生了高质量的SFT数据库数据集,有6 368个样本。 对于RL,我们使用TreatyVGRL数据集,该数据集由V *V^{*}Q列车集(Wu & Xie,2023)和VisDrone(Zhu等,2021年)的问题组成. 此外,我们还通过在SFT QA装置上推出一个文本和一个理由确凿的SFT检查站来补充RL培训,并在两个检查站下添加任何问题,包括通行证@8[0.2,0.8]\text{pass@8}\in [0.2.0.8]。

blocks.en: Training . Following prior work ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , we first perform a cold-start SFT stage before reinforcement learning. Unless otherwise specified, we initialize from the Qwen3-VL 8B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) instruct model. More recent models, such as Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , are explicitly trained for grounded reasoning. To isolate the effect of our training recipe, we use an older model. For RL, we apply a format, correctness, and grounding reward. We do not apply the grounding reward for text reasoning checkpoints. We train using LlamaFactory ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) and veRL ( Sheng et al., 2024 ) . Our RL training setup follows TreeVGR, but we use a slightly altered grounding reward from Jiang et al. (2025) (see Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 培训 以往工作(Wang等人,2026a; Zhang等,2026a),我们首先在强化学习前进行冷起SFT阶段. 除非另有说明,我们从Quen3-VL 8B(Bai等,2025年a)指示模型中初始化。 更近期的模型,如Quen3.5 (Quen Team,2026a.),被明确训练为有根据的推理. 为了隔离我们训练食谱的效果,我们采用了更古老的模式. 对RL来说,我们采用一种格式、正确性和基础奖励。 我们不给文本推理检查点以奖励。 我们使用LlamaFactory(郑等,2024年)和veRL(盛等,2024年)进行训练. 我们的RL训练设置跟随了TreeVGR,但我们使用的是来自Jiang等人(2025年)的略微改变的地基奖励(见附录B.).

blocks.en: Table 2: Appended vs reflection performance . The reflection reasoning style yields significantly better performance on counting.
blocks.zh: 表2: 附加的反射性能 反射推理风格通过计数产生出显著的更好的性能.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Results

Table 3: Training recipe comparison . We report the performance of grounded reasoning and text-only reasoning training recipes after SFT and RL training phases. Deltas that exclude 0 from the confidence interval are highlighted. We find that grounding provides a statistically significant benefit on counting, but not on spatial reasoning or perception.
blocks.zh: 表3:培训方法比较 我们报告在SFT和RL培训阶段之后,有根据的推理和仅文本的推理培训方法的表现。 将0排除在信任间隔之外的三角洲被突出显示。 我们发现,基于计算在统计学上提供了重大的好处,但并不涉及空间推理或感知。

blocks.en: Coordinate accuracy affects grounding usage, but not accuracy . We first study how the accuracy of the grounding annotations in training affects downstream performance and grounding usage. We randomize varying percentages of the coordinates in our SFT training set and examine the downstream SFT checkpoint performance on SpatialMQA, MultihopSpatial, TreeBench, and CountQA. We also perform the coordinate randomization test on each checkpoint on MultihopSpatial. We report our results in Figure 3 . We find that grounding usage decreases significantly as a larger percentage of coordinates is randomized, with the delta going from − 3.63 -3.63 at 0 % 0\% randomized to − 0.15 -0.15 at 100 % 100\% randomized. This result suggests that noise in the training data may cause the model not to use its grounding. It also supports design decisions in Lu et al. (2026) , which note the importance of having high-quality ground truth in the SFT stage. Furthermore, while grounding usage decreases, we find that performance generally remains flat across spatial reasoning and fine-grained perception benchmarks, but decreases monotonically for CountQA. The lack of correlation between grounding usage and performance suggests that existing perception and spatial reasoning benchmarks do not benefit from better grounded reasoning. On the other hand, counting benefits significantly from effective grounded reasoning.
blocks.zh: 坐标精确度影响地面使用,但不准确。 我们首先研究培训中打地标说明的准确性如何影响下游的业绩和打地标的使用。 我们在SFT训练集中随机抽取不同比例的坐标,并检查下游SFT检查站在SpaceMQA,MultihopSpatial,Tree Bench和CounterQA上的性能. 我们还在MultihopSpatial的每个检查站进行坐标随机化测试。 我们在图3中报告结果。 我们发现地基使用量显著减少,因为更大的坐标百分比是随机的,三角洲从-3.63-3.63,0-%随机化为-0.15-0.15,100-%随机化。 这一结果表明,培训数据中的噪音可能导致模型不使用其地基. 它还支持Lu等人(2026年)的设计决定,其中指出在SFT阶段拥有高质量的地上真理的重要性. 此外,虽然基本使用减少,但我们认为,在空间推理和精细感知基准方面,性能一般保持平平,但对QA伯爵而言,则单调下降。 基准使用和性能之间缺乏相关性表明,现有感知和空间推理基准不能从更有依据的推理中受益。 另一方面,从有效的有根据的推理中计数大有裨益。

blocks.en: Reasoning templates affect grounding usage . We also ablate various strategies commonly used to insert grounding data in reasoning traces. We consider two approaches: Appended , where grounding coordinates are appended when relevant objects are mentioned during reasoning, and Reflection , where the traces contain a reflection phrase “Let’s look at [coordinate]” (see Appendix 6 for examples). We find that reflection results in significantly more grounding usage than appending grounding coordinates (Table 1 ) and also much better performance on counting (Table 2 ). These results show that “hinting” the model to use its grounding can be an effective strategy for improving performance. As such, we opt to use the reflection format in all other experiments.
blocks.zh: 理性模板影响地基使用 我们还放弃了通常用于在推理痕迹中插入地基数据的各种战略。 我们考虑两种办法:附加办法,在推理时提及有关物体时附取地坐标;反射办法,其中的痕迹包含一个反射短语 " 让我们看看[协  " (例子见附录6)。 我们发现,反思的结果是,比起附加地平坐标(表1),地面使用率要高得多,而且计算(表2)的表现要好得多。 这些结果表明,“打点”模式使用其地基可以成为提高业绩的有效战略。 因此,我们选择在所有其他试验中使用反射格式。

blocks.en: Grounding recipes are not generally better than text-only recipes . We report the performance of grounded and ungrounded training recipes after SFT and after RL in Table 3 . After SFT, the delta between grounded and ungrounded recipes is positive and significant for both counting benchmarks (+3.6 on CountQA and +2.6 on FSC-147), but is not significant on any spatial reasoning or fine-grained perception benchmarks. Similarly, after RL, only the counting benchmarks retain a significant positive delta, while we see regressions for MultihopSpatial, EmbSpatial, and VSR. These results suggest that even with high-quality training data and high grounding usage, grounded reasoning is generally helpful for counting tasks but not for spatial reasoning and perception. Based on these results, we seek to understand why grounded reasoning benefits some tasks, but not others.
blocks.zh: 基本食谱一般不优于只用文字的食谱。 我们在表3中报告在SFT之后和RL之后的无根据和无根据培训菜谱的业绩。 在SFT之后,被禁食和无禁食食谱之间的三角洲对于两个计数基准都是积极而重要的(CounterQA的+3.6和FSC-147的+2.6),但在任何空间推理或精细的感知基准上都不重要. 同样,在RL之后,只有计数基准保留了显著的正三角形,而我们看到了MultihopSpatial、EmbSpatial和VSR的回归. 这些结果表明,即使有高质量的培训数据和高基础的使用,有根据的推理通常有助于计算任务,而不利于空间推理和感知。 基于这些结果,我们力求理解为什么有根据的推理有利于一些任务,而不利于其他任务。

blocks.en: 4 Why Is Grounding Useful?
blocks.zh: 4 为什么铺地有用?

blocks.en: Figure 4: Synthetic Probe Tasks . We use three synthetic tasks to study where grounded reasoning improves over pure text reasoning. We find that grounding performs significantly better than text reasoning when no text-labels are available, but worse when given text labels. Zoom in for detail.
blocks.zh: 图4:合成探测任务. 我们用三个合成任务来研究有根据的推理比纯文本推理改进的地方. 我们认为,在没有文本标签的情况下,打地功能明显优于文字推理,但在给定文本标签时则更为糟糕。 放大以详之.

blocks.en: We hypothesize that grounding is primarily beneficial when the task requires an undescribable reference . To illustrate this claim, we develop several synthetic tasks to probe where grounded reasoning improves over pure text reasoning. These tasks are designed to represent situations that are particularly difficult to solve with textual references. In particular, we use arbitrary shapes and a uniform color to prevent textual identification by common shape or color names. We also non-uniformly scatter objects, which makes maintaining the position of objects difficult using plain text.
blocks.zh: 我们假设,当任务需要难以描述的参考时,确定地基主要是有益的。 为了说明这一说法,我们开发出几项合成任务,以探究有根据的推理比纯文本推理改进之处. 这些任务旨在代表特别难以用文字参考来解决的情况。 特别是,我们使用任意的形状和统一的颜色来防止以常见的形状或颜色名称进行文字识别. 我们还不统一地分散物体,这就使得难以使用纯文本来维持物体的位置。

blocks.en: Probe tasks . We consider three tasks, shown in Figure 4 . In wire-tracing , the model is given a left terminal and must determine which right terminal its wire reaches. In visually prompted counting , one polygon is outlined, and the model must count how many shapes are identical to it. In arrow following , the model starts at an outlined blob and follows the arrows for several hops, before pointing to the final blob. Each task requires tracking undescribable visual references, such as the current position along a wire, the set of shapes already counted, or the current blob in the chain. Generation parameters and answer formats are given in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 探测任务。 我们考虑三项任务,如图4所示。 在电线追踪中,模型被赋予了左终端,必须确定它的电线到达哪个右终端. 在视觉激发的计数中,勾画出一个多边形,模型必须计算出与它完全相同的形状. 在跟随的箭头中,模型从一个被概括的blob开始并跟随箭头进行数个跳动,然后指向最后的blob. 每项任务都需要跟踪无法描述的可视参考文献,例如线条上目前的位置,已经计数的形状集,或者链条上当前的blob. 生成参数和答案格式见附录D。

blocks.en: Experimental setup. For each task, we finetune Qwen3-VL-8B on 3 different reasoning variations: direct, text CoT, and grounded CoT. In the “direct” setting, no chain-of-thought is provided, and the model directly predicts the correct answer. In “text CoT,” we use plain text chain-of-thought, where positions of objects are described using language. In “grounded CoT,” we represent the positions of objects using [x, y] coordinates instead. To examine the benefit of grounding when positions in the image can be localized with language, we also re-render each task with text labels on objects or positions relevant for solving the task, as demonstrated in Figure 4 . For these re-renders, we adjust the “text CoT” traces to refer to the precise text labels. Each variant is trained once and greedily decoded during evaluation.
blocks.zh: 实验设置. 对于每项任务,我们微调了Qwen3-VL-8B的三种不同的推理变体:直接的,文本的COT,以及被基于的COT. 在“直接”环境中,不提供思维链,模型直接预测正确的答案。 在“Text CoT”中,我们使用纯文本的思想链,其中用语言描述物体的位置。 在“有根据的COT”中,我们代表的是使用[x,y]坐标的物体的位置。 为了审查在图像中的位置可以随语言本地化时打地基的好处,我们还将每个任务在与解决任务相关的对象或位置上重新打上文字标签,如图4所示. 对于这些重报,我们调整了“文本CoT”的痕迹,以提及准确的文本标签。 每个变体都经过过一次培训,在评价过程中贪婪地解码.

blocks.en: Grounded reasoning is helpful when text references are unavailable. We report our results in Figure 4 . On the unlabeled scenes, we see that grounded reasoning improves significantly over text reasoning (69.3 vs 24.4 on wire-tracing) and direct fine-tuning (95.2 vs 34.4 on counting). However, once labels are added, the value of grounding over text reasoning drops significantly. We observe that text reasoning outperforms grounded reasoning on all three tasks when given text labels. As such, we conclude that grounding is primarily helpful when no textual references are available to solve a task.
blocks.zh: 在无法提供文本参考时,有依据的推理很有帮助。 我们在图4中报告结果。 在无标签的场景上,我们看到,有根据的推理比文字推理(69.3 vs 24.4 on racing)和直接微调(95.2 vs 34.4 on count)大有改进. 然而,一旦添加了标签,基于文字推理的价值就大幅下降。 我们注意到,当给定文本标签时,文本推理在所有三项任务上都超越了有根据的推理。 因此,我们的结论是,如果没有文字参考来完成某项任务,确定理由主要是有益的。

blocks.en: 5 BrickVision
blocks.zh: 5 Brick Vision (英语).

blocks.en: Figure 5: BrickVision . Samples from each task distribution of our BrickVision evaluation set. BrickVision tasks involve iterative comparison across objects difficult to describe in language, and require precise answers in the form of a point or integer.
blocks.zh: 图5: " 砖景 " 我们的BrickVision评价集的每个任务分布样本. BrickVision任务涉及在语言中难以描述的对象之间进行迭代比较,需要以点或整数的形式给出精确的答案.

blocks.en: Our study in Section 4 demonstrates that grounding capabilities are best illustrated on benchmarks that require undescribable references. However, because existing benchmarks have objects that are uniquely describable in text, they are easy to solve using textual references. To address this gap, we use our insights from Section 4 to create BrickVision, a benchmark that requires undescribable references to solve.
blocks.zh: 我们在第4节的研究表明,基础能力最好以需要难以形容的参考基准来说明。 然而,由于现有的基准对象在文本中具有独一无二的可被可分解性,因此使用文本引用很容易解决. 为了弥补这一差距,我们利用第4节的见解,创建了Brick Vision,这个基准需要无法形容的参考物来解决.

blocks.en: Benchmark construction . BrickVision contains four different task types, described in Figure 5 . Each task type has 250 samples, for a total of 1000 questions in the benchmark. Each task is designed to require iterative comparison over every pile of bricks. Both the precise geometry and position of the piles are difficult to describe in language, which necessitates the effective use of undescribable visual references.
blocks.zh: 基准建设. BrickVision包含四种不同的任务类型,如图5所描述. 每种任务类型有250个样本,基准中共有1000个问题. 每项任务的设计都要求每堆砖进行迭代比较. 堆积的精确几何和位置都难以用语言描述,这就需要有效使用无法描述的可视参考.

blocks.en: To create BrickVision, we combine procedural generation with generative style transfer. For each task type, we create a procedural generator of isometric 2D scenes. We then pass this synthetic render into Nano Banana ( Google, 2026 ) to restyle the image and use the original segmentation map as ground truth for the tasks that require point output (Appendix 9 ). In order to use the original segmentation as ground-truth, the restyled scene must be aligned with the original synthetic render. However, we find that passing just the synthetic render to Nano-Banana results in misalignment of the segmentation masks, as shown in Appendix 10 . As such, we prompt the model with an additional render featuring bounding boxes of the block stacks and fix the aspect ratio during generation.
blocks.zh: 为了创造出"BrickVision",我们把程序生成和基因风格转移结合起来. 对于每个任务类型,我们创建一个同位素2D场景的程序生成器. 然后我们把这个合成的渲染器传入纳诺香蕉 (Google, 2026年), 为了将原始分解用作地上真能,所恢复的场景必须与原始合成成像相配合. 然而,我们发现,正如附录10所示,仅仅通过合成成像到纳诺-巴纳纳就会导致分解口罩的错位。 因此,我们用一个额外的外观来推动模型,其外观以块堆放的边框为主,并在生成过程中修正了外观比.

blocks.en: Table 4: VLM performance on BrickVision . Many frontier models struggle on BrickVision, suggesting limited ability to maintain undescribable visual references. Models trained with in-domain grounding data perform better than text reasoning, demonstrating the benefit of grounded reasoning.
blocks.zh: 表4: BrickVision上的VLM性能 . 许多前沿模型在"BrickVision"上挣扎,表明维持无法描述的视觉参考的能力有限. 受过域内地基数据培训的模型比文字推理表现得更好,证明了有根据推理的好处.

blocks.en: BrickVision Evaluations. We evaluate a variety of models on BrickVision and report our results in Table 4 . We find that many existing models struggle on BrickVision, with strong multimodal models such as Gemini 3.8 Flash scoring just 15.5%. On the other hand, GPT-6 Astra is significantly stronger than all other models, scoring 68.7% overall. We observe that Qwen 3.8 Max often points to empty regions of the image, unlike other frontier models which reliably point to a valid pile, which may suggest weaker overall grounding capabilities. More broadly, these results suggest that many existing frontier models have limited capability to reason over undescribable references. The performance disparity between GPT-6 Astra and other frontier models is particularly stark, and further work could attempt to analyze why this is the case.
blocks.zh: BrickVision评价. 我们评价各种模式的 " Brick Vision " ,并在表4中报告结果。 我们发现,许多现有的模型在"Brick Vision"上挣扎,有强大的多式模型,如双子座3.8 Flash评分只有15.5%. 另一方面,GPT-6 Astra比其他所有型号都显著强大,总得分为68.7%. 我们注意到,Quen 3.8 Max经常指向图像的空地,不同于其他前沿模型,它们可靠地指向一个有效的堆积物,这可能表明整体起落能力较弱. 更广泛地说,这些结果表明,许多现有前沿模型比难以描述的参考文献更难以解释。 GPT-6 Astra与其他前沿模型之间的性能差距尤其明显,今后的工作可以试图分析为什么出现这种情况。

blocks.en: Finally, to validate that the benchmark benefits from grounded reasoning, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) on the pre-style-transfer images and ablate grounded and pure text reasoning strategies. We find that grounded reasoning significantly outperforms text-only reasoning (82.9 vs 61.2). Note that these fine-tuned results are intended as a diagnostic for the usefulness of grounding, as BrickVision is designed to evaluate models that have not been trained directly for the task.
blocks.zh: 最后,为了证实基准从基于推理中获益,我们微调了Qwen3.5-9B(Quen Team,2026a.)在风格前转移图像和被放弃的基于和纯文本推理策略上. 我们认为,基于理由的推理大大超过了仅以文字为理由的推理(82.9 vs 61.2)。 请注意,这些微调的结果是为了诊断地基的有用性,因为Brick Vision旨在评价没有直接接受过任务培训的模型.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We have provided both a detailed analysis of where and why visual grounding is most useful and a benchmark to help guide future research on grounded reasoning. However, we note an interesting conundrum: grounded reasoning is most useful on tasks that are difficult to describe in language, but automatic methods of acquiring grounding rely on text referring expressions. So how can we acquire labels for grounded reasoning at scale? We hope future work will shed light on this question.
blocks.zh: 我们既详细分析了何地和为何视觉定位最有用,也提供了一个基准,以帮助指导今后对有根据推理的研究。 然而,我们注意到一个令人感兴趣的难题:基于理由的推理对于在语言上难以描述的任务最为有用,但自动获得理由的方法依赖于提及表达的文字。 那么,我们怎样才能获得标签来进行大规模的理由论证呢? 我们希望今后的工作将澄清这一问题。

blocks.en: Training details. For wire-tracing and visually prompted counting, we finetune on training sets of 5k QA samples. Empirically, we found arrow-following to be a more difficult task and instead generate 50k QA samples for training. In each experiment, we train for 1 epoch.

blocks.en: Task generation. We describe the generation procedure and answer format for each probe task.
blocks.zh: 任务生成. 我们描述每个探测任务的生成程序和答案格式。

blocks.en: Wire-tracing. Each image has eight labeled terminals on both the left and right sides. Wires between terminals are generated with Catmull-Rom splines ( Catmull & Rom, 1974 ) . Given the letter of a left terminal, the model must identify the right terminal that its wire reaches.
blocks.zh: 有线追踪. 每个图像有8个标有标签的终端在左右两侧. 终端之间的线由Catmull-Rom splines(Catmull & Rom, 1974)生成. 鉴于左起站的字母,模型必须识别其电线所到达的右起站.

blocks.en: Visually prompted counting. Each image contains K ∈ { 29 , 35 , 41 } K\in\{29,35,41\} gray polygons. One polygon is outlined in blue and duplicated M ∈ { 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 } M\in\{9,10,11,12\} times. The model must output the number of shapes identical to the outlined one as an integer.
blocks.zh: 直观地促使计数。 每个图像包含 K { { 29, 35, 41} K\ in} 29, 35, 41} 灰色多边形 。 一个多边形以蓝色和重复的M {{ { 9, 10, 11, 12}} M\in} 9, 10, 11, 12} 次 。 该模型必须输出与被概述的形状完全相同的形状数,作为整数.

blocks.en: Arrow following. Each scene contains 48 blobs, each with one arrow pointing to another blob. The start blob is outlined in blue. The model must follow the arrows for H ∈ { 2 , 4 , 6 } H\in\{2,4,6\} hops and point to the final blob, answering with an [x, y] coordinate normalized to [0, 1000] following standard practice ( Clark et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 箭头跟着 每个场景包含48个blob,每个会有一个箭指向另一个blob. 开始的blob以蓝色来概括. 该型号必须跟随H {}{2,4,6}的箭头,H\in}2,4,6}跳出并指向最后的blob,按照标准惯例(Clark等,2026.),用 [x,y] 坐标正常化为 [0,1000].

blocks.en: Appendix E BrickVision
blocks.zh: 附录 E

blocks.en: We consider four task types in BrickVision: Duplicate, Crop ID, Unpaired, and Fine-grained Counting.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑在 BrickVision 中的四个任务类型:复制、农作物ID、未受污染和精细的计数。

blocks.en: Duplicate. Each scene has 10 to 12 stacks in the same colors, exactly two of which share a design, and the model must point to both. Every other stack differs from the shared design in the orientation or position of one or two bricks, so no single attribute separates the pair from the rest.
blocks.zh: 复相传相. 每个场景有10到12个同色的堆放,其中正中两个堆放共用一个设计,模型必须指向两者. 每个其他堆栈在一两块砖的取向或位置上与共享设计不同,因此没有单一的属性将相配部分与其余部分相分离.

blocks.en: Crop ID. Each image shows a scene of 10 structures next to an enlarged inset of one of them. In the inset, two or three of the structure’s five pieces are masked to silhouettes and one of the masked pieces is outlined. All structures use the same color for a given piece and differ only in the offset of a side marker and the position of the cap, so the model has to find the inset’s structure in the scene by geometry and then point to the outlined piece.
blocks.zh: 农作物标识. 每个图像都显示一个场景,旁边有10个结构,旁边是其中1个被放大的相间. 在套装中,5个结构的2个或3个被遮住以被遮住,其中1个被遮住的被勾勒出. 所有结构对给定的棋子都使用相同的颜色,只在相向标记和盖子位置的相向偏移上有所不同,所以模型必须在场景中用几何来找到被套的结构,然后指向被勾画出棋子.

blocks.en: Unpaired. Each scene has 10 to 13 stacks in the same colors. Every stack has an identical copy somewhere in the scene except one, and the groups of copies differ from each other only in geometry. The model must point to the stack that has no copy.
blocks.zh: 未发菩提心. 每个场景有10至13个同色堆. 每堆相片除了一部外,在现场的某个地方都有一模一样的相片拷贝,而相片的相片组只在几何上有所不同. 模型必须指向没有副本的堆栈.

blocks.en: Fine-grained Counting. The task is to determine how many 2 × \times 4 bricks satisfy a particular geometric predicate. We consider several predicates, such as having a 1 × \times 1 brick on top, touching a 1 × \times 1 at a short end, or resting crosswise on the brick below. The scenes also contain bricks of other shapes that satisfy the predicate, so the model must check each brick’s shape as well as the predicate. Ground truth counts range from 2 to 7.
blocks.zh: 精进取数. 任务是确定有多少个2×\times 4个砖块满足了特定的几何上游. 我们考虑几个前提,比如上方有1×××正时1个砖块,在短端上触出1××正时1个砖块,或者在下方砖块上交叉休息. 场景还包含能满足上游的其他形状的砖块,因此模型必须检查每个砖块的形状以及上游. 地面真理计数从2到7不等.

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows the pipeline used to generate the final benchmark images. A procedural generator renders an isometric scene and its segmentation map, and Nano-Banana restyles the render. Figure 10 shows the drift that occurs without a fixed aspect ratio and bounding-box conditioning.
blocks.zh: 图9显示用于生成最终基准图像的管道。 程序生成器会制作同位素场景及其分片图,而纳诺-巴纳纳会重塑渲染. 图10显示的是没有固定宽度比和边框条件的漂移。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Benchmark construction . Our benchmark combines procedural generation with conditional image generation to produce realistic images aligned with the original synthetic ground truth.
blocks.zh: 图9:基准建设 我们的基准将程序生成与有条件的图像生成结合起来,以产生符合原始合成地真能的现实图像.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Restyling drift . Without locking the aspect ratio or prompting Nano-Banana with bounding boxes, we find that the restyled image drifts from the original, making the segmentation map ground truth (visualized as an overlay) incorrect.
blocks.zh: 图10:静态漂移。 在没有锁定外观比或用边框来提示纳米-巴拿那的情况下,我们发现被重置的图像从原作中漂移出,使得分块图地真(可视化为覆被)不正确.
